description: Scripted-fault fixture for the retry backoff layer (#59). The form→results click times out on its first 8 triggers — enough to exhaust any test's retry budget — so a payload retries into a retryable-exhausted failure and every retry between attempts backs off. Used to assert the per-strategy backoff delay sequence (constant/linear/exponential) flows through the injected clock. The attempt count is per-transition on the session (resets with a fresh run).
